code = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pos = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v in (2, 8):
                pos[v] = (r, c)
    r2, c2 = pos[2]
    r8, c8 = pos[8]
    out[r2][c2] = 7
    out[r8][c8] = 2
    rows5 = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    out[max(rows5)][c8 + 1] = 8
    return out
'''
